items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1960-01-03
items.q: My father happened to be a musician, and I'd take his cornet and sneak it down the back in an empty house in the next block

ctx.x: And I tried to teach myself. My father happened to be a musician, and I'd take his cornet and sneak it down the back in an empty house in the next block, and I'd try to learn on it.
You mean to tell me he didn't want you to play music?
